g.text: POST /api/auth/register; hash password with bcrypt; initialize user doc
POST /api/auth/login; verify bcrypt hash; emit socket user_online
PUT /api/profile/:userId; update lifestyle criteria & budget preferences
calculateCompatibility(); compute weighted compatibility score (budget 25, food 20, sleep 20, etc.)
POST /api/friend-requests; validate unique sender-recipient pair; emit socket alert
PUT /api/friend-requests/:id/accept; create conversation entity with 2 participants
GET /api/properties; client/server filtering by budget, location, and type
POST /api/properties; store amenities, location, photos; status 'pending'
POST /api/meals/subscribe; link subscriber to daily tiffin menu
POST /api/expenses; calculate equal/custom splits; notify co-tenants
POST /api/agreements; compile house rules, 50/50 rent share, security deposit
emit("send_message"); persist Message document; update conversation timestamp
emit("message_read"); bulk-update isRead flags; notify sender
POST /api/reviews; record rating and commentary for target entity
POST /api/reports; log target ID, reporter ID, rationale; set 'Under Review'
PUT /api/reports/:id; execute ban, content purge, or dismissal
